  QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C f →

        (s : QuarticQuery.Address r),
        QuarticQuery.PaperWinsAt f C ℓ r x i s ↔

            (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C ℓ r i s e).eval x = QuarticQuery.localTest C ℓ r x i s e) ∧

inspection.type:
∀ {k t : ℕ} (C : QuarticQuery.Circuit (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (A : ℕ),
  1 ≤ t →
    QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t) →
      C.size ≤ A * QuarticQuery.mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 2 →
        (∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t)) (e : Fin (2 ^ (2 * t) - 1))
            (q : Fin (2 * t) ⊕ QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)),
            ∃ X Y,
              (∀ (p : QuarticQuery.BitLoc (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
                  p ≠ QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionPointerLoc C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e q → X p = Y p) ∧
                QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) X i s (Sum.inr (Sum.inl e)) ≠
                  QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) Y i s (Sum.inr (Sum.inl e))) ∧
          Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) =
              QuarticQuery.mValue t + (QuarticQuery.mValue t - 1) + 40 * t * (C.size + 2) ∧
            Fintype.card (QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) ≤
                (42 + 20 * A) * QuarticQuery.mValue t * (2 * t) ^ 3 ∧
              (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t))
                  (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t)),
                  QuarticQuery.PaperWinsAt (QuarticQuery.P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s ↔
                    ∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                      QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e = Bool.true) ∧
                (∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t))
                    (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                    (∀
                        (x :
                          QuarticQuery.BitInput
                            (QuarticQuery.BitLoc (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))),
                        (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).eval x =
                          QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x i s e) ∧
                      (QuarticQuery.localTestTree C (2 * t) (40 * t) i s e).depth ≤ 2 * t + 1) ∧
                  ∀ (i : QuarticQuery.Column (2 * t)) (s : QuarticQuery.Address (40 * t)),
                    ∃ Z instZ,
                      have x := instZ;
                      ∃ o out F,
                        (∀ (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                            QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (Max.max 3 (2 * t + 1)) (F e)) ∧
                          (QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (Max.max 3 (2 * t + 1)) fun x_1 =>
                              QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1) ∧
                            (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                (a : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size → ℂ)
                                (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size),
                                (QuarticQuery.Upper.slice e)
                                    ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1)
                                      (QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionIndexStart o a)) =
                                  a e • (F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e))) ∧
                              (∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                  (e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) (z : Z e),
                                  out e z ≠ QuarticQuery.localTest C (2 * t) (40 * t) x_1 i s e →
                                    ((F e x_1) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket (o e))).ofLp z = 0) ∧
                                ∃ w emb P,
                                  ∀ (next : QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C) w),
                                    (P next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (2 * t + 1) + next.queryCap ∧
                                      ∀ (x_1 : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.Upper.Loc k t C))
                                        (ψ :
                                          QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg
                                            ((e : QuarticQuery.TestIndex (2 * t) (40 * t) C.size) × Z e))
                                        (b : Bool),
                                        (P next).outputMass x_1 ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b =
                                          next.outputMass x_1
                                            ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb)
                                              ((QuarticQuery.Upper.sigmaOp fun e => F e x_1) ψ))
                                            b

ledger_history.earlier_ledger_wording: For every input y and (i,s) in [m] x {0,1}^r: i wins at s iff all K_{k,m} tests pass, namely (a) X_i[b]=1 for each b; (b) for each j != i, X_j[p_{i,s,j}]=0; (c) for each h and each non-input gate, the claimed value equals the gate function of its predecessors, read from the transcript or from A_{i,h}; (d) for each h, claimed d=1 and claimed b=s_h. Each test is a function of O(log m) input bits, at most l+1 for (b) and at most 3 for (c).

presentation.body: For every input $y$ and $(i,s)\in[m]\times\{0,1\}^r$: $i$ wins at $s$ if and only if all $K_{k,m}$ tests pass, namely (a) $X_i[b]=1$ for each $b$; (b) for each $j\ne i$, $X_j[p_{i,s,j}]=0$; (c) for each $h$ and each non-input gate, the claimed value equals the gate function of its predecessors, read from the transcript or from $A_{i,h}$; (d) for each $h$, claimed $d=1$ and claimed $b=s_h$. Each test is computed by a deterministic adaptive bit-query decision tree of depth at most $\max(3,\ell+1)$, which is $\ell+1$ for $m\ge4$: a pointer test reads $\ell$ pointer bits, then the one target bit they select, while gate tests read at most three fixed bits. A pointer test is not a function of a small fixed set of bits: it can depend on all $\ell+m$ pointer and target coordinates.
presentation.body_plain: For every input y and (i, s) ∈ [m] × the set of length-r binary strings: i wins at s if and only if all Kₖ,ₘ tests pass, namely (a) Xᵢ[b] = 1 for each b; (b) for each j ≠ i, Xⱼ[pᵢ,ₛ,ⱼ] = 0; (c) for each h and each non-input gate, the claimed value equals the gate function of its predecessors, read from the transcript or from Aᵢ,ₕ; (d) for each h, claimed d = 1 and claimed b = sₕ. Each test is computed by a deterministic adaptive bit-query decision tree of depth at most max(3, ℓ + 1), which is ℓ + 1 for m ≥ 4: a pointer test reads ℓ pointer bits, then the one target bit they select, while gate tests read at most three fixed bits. A pointer test is not a function of a small fixed set of bits: it can depend on all ℓ + m pointer and target coordinates.
